_comment: The reporter is a HUMAN, not an AI agent. They pass the incident to the intake. Their name is personal data and never leaves the operator's node -- at most the assessor learns that there was a reporter.

reporter.name: Jens Ahlgrimm (fictional)
reporter.statement: Small obstruction in front of the locomotive, light impact. Train continues normally, track clear. The refrigeration unit on reefer wagon W02 is running rough.
